risk_note: RV2 (content page audience facts). GET /v1/pages/{page_key} now evaluates section conditions union_authorized and has_order for signed-in users through a content-owned read port PageAudienceReads, wired in app.module.ts from read ports linking and identity already export (content imports no other module). Anonymous users get all facts false without a query; signed-in users get at most one read per request, only for facts the selected version uses, never cached across requests. union_authorized is true when any platform binding is active; a failed platform read with the others unauthorized gives unknown, not false. A failed read makes only that fact unknown (warn log, page still 200); sections whose condition is yes/no on an unknown fact are withheld, 'any' sections are served. has_parent is not wired yet (identity exports no read port; TODO left, those sections withheld for signed-in users). No funds, no writes. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
